name: Celery Juice
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as celery is low FODMAP. However, large volumes of any juice may cause digestive upset in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use fresh celery stalks and juice immediately for best nutrient retention
Strain if you prefer a smoother consistency without pulp
Start with smaller amounts (1/2 cup) if new to celery juice
Drink on an empty stomach for maximum absorption
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin K for bone health
Good source of potassium for heart health
Low in calories and naturally hydrating
